title: Deleted in 1 tap, kept 3 years (EP44: Privacy)
label: EP44

lines.text: One tap to delete, Amma... [1] but if Gemini's reviewers read it, it can stay three years!
lines.show: One tap to delete, Amma... but if Gemini's reviewers read it, it can stay 3 years!

lines.text: With my account number? [1] And my PAN?!
lines.show: With my account number? And my PAN?!

lines.text: Reviewers at the company read some chats, to improve the AI. [1] That copy isn't deleted when you delete yours.
lines.show: Reviewers at the company read some chats, to improve the AI. That copy isn't deleted when you delete yours.

lines.text: I only asked where my salary goes!
lines.show: I only asked where my salary goes!

lines.text: Gemini's own privacy page says: [1] don't type what you wouldn't want a reviewer to see.
lines.show: Gemini's own privacy page says: don't type what you wouldn't want a reviewer to see.

lines.text: But it needs my details to help me!
lines.show: But it needs my details to help me!

lines.text: We tested it. Your statement, ten times with your numbers, <pause 0.25> [1] ten times with them blanked out.
lines.show: We tested it. Your statement, ten times with your numbers, ten times with them blanked out.
lines.tts: We tested it. Your statement, ten times with your numbers,
lines.tts2: ten times with them blanked out.

lines.text: With or without your numbers, it found the food orders. [1] It never needed your PAN.
lines.show: With or without your numbers, it found the food orders. It never needed your PAN.

lines.text: So I just blank them out?
lines.show: So I just blank them out?

lines.text: Your name, your account number, your PAN: [1] blank them out before you paste. <pause 0.6> [2] And in Gemini, switch off Keep Activity.
lines.show: Your name, your account number, your PAN: blank them out before you paste. And in Gemini, switch off Keep Activity.
lines.tts: Your name, your account number, your PAN: blank them out before you paste.
lines.tts2: And in Gemini, switch off Keep Activity.

lines.text: Done! [1] And I'll send the passbook photo too!
lines.show: Done! And I'll send the passbook photo too!

lines.text: Amma, the photo has your account numb—
lines.show: Amma, the photo has your account numb—
